title: Production paper producer gives the expression layer a book and a risk budget
author: Claude
hosted_statement: Hosted behaviour was NOT exercised. No VM, SSH, hosted BFF, workflow dispatch, live order, broker sandbox or model provider call was made. All evidence below is functional (unit/contract tests with the real 2026-11-09 shapes and only the HTTP transport replaced). Hosted verification belongs to INSTRUMENT-EXPRESSION-HOSTED-ACCEPTANCE-20261107.
root_cause: _runner_strategy returned CurrentArtifactStrategy() without expression_inputs; nothing wrote metadata.expression_inputs in production, so build_candidates saw no gross_limit/available_cash and fail-closed max_units_by_risk to 0 (reported as gross_limit).

changes.services/execution/lean_runtime/expressi: new: CapitalPoolReader (GET /api/capital-pools/{id}), RuntimeSummaryReader (telemetry runtime summary), build_expression_inputs (pure), ExpressionInputsProvider using resolve_bound_pool_risk_policy; ExpressionInputsUnavailable names the missing input
changes.services/execution/lean_runtime/paper_si: _runner_strategy installs build_production_expression_inputs(); _expression_step turns ExpressionInputsUnavailable into a candidates_unavailable NoTrade with detail 'budget_unavailable: <input>'
changes.services/execution/lean_runtime/instrume: _remaining_gross also honours max_leverage x equity when both are supplied (tighter bound wins); budgets without them are unchanged
changes.services/telemetry/runtime_summary.py: summary now publishes ledger_cash, ledger_cash_fill_count, ledger_cash_as_of from paper_fill_simulated metadata (highest ledger fill count wins; cleared on binding rollover)
changes.services/execution/lean_runtime/paper_ru: main()/get_service() accept capital_pool_reader; main() defaults it from the environment because the reconciler launches paper_runtime.py directly
changes.docker-compose.yml: paper-signal-producer gets PANTHEON_TELEMETRY_API_URL, PANTHEON_CAPITAL_API_URL and the capital read principal env; paper-fleet-reconciler (parent env of every paper runtime worker) gets the capital URL and principal env

input_sources.limits: pool metadata.risk_policy via services.capital.risk_policy.resolve_bound_pool_risk_policy; gross_limit and max_leverage are multiples of equity, converted to an absolute amount by build_expression_inputs; no number is hardcoded
input_sources.cash_and_positions: telemetry runtime summary for binding.runtime_id (ledger_cash, positions); the provisioned pool budget while the ledger has no fill
input_sources.equity: ledger_cash + cash-share holdings value + futures unrealized (matches paper_runtime.ledger_reconciliation_snapshot)

acceptance_mapping.1: test_paper_signal_producer.py::TestExpressionInputsProductionWiring::test_runner_strategy_carries_the_provider_and_calls_it_per_binding (strategy built by _runner_strategy exactly as main does; provider present and called; budget carries equity, available_cash, absolute gross_limit, gross_used, max_leverage; book carries positions and gross_notional)
acceptance_mapping.2: test_expression_inputs.py (real pool policy shape, real runtime summary shape; limits only from policy, no constants) and test_runtime_summary_projection.py::TestLedgerCashProjection
acceptance_mapping.3: TestExpressionInputsProductionWiring::test_hosted_long_views_choose_the_cash_share_and_never_no_trade (2330 @2235, 0050 @92.5, 2317 @225; strength 1.0; only eq:<code> candidate; pool budget 100000; gross_limit 2.0 -> Chosen eq buy with units from dev plan 4.4 capped by cash: 44, 1081, 444). 0050 and 2317 prices are plan/fixture figures, not hosted readings
acceptance_mapping.4: TestExpressionInputsProductionWiring: policy_missing, pool_budget_missing, ledger_unreadable, unconfigured_services, and a real gross limit bind still reports gross_limit
acceptance_mapping.5: test_runtime_bootstrap.py::RuntimeBootstrapOrderGatePolicyTests (run() hands main() the reader; gate rejects 2.247x with limit 2.0 and required/available/limit, accepts 0.5x; gross_limit alone, equity-only asset class)
acceptance_mapping.6: flag-off and legacy artifact test (no service read, no expression key); existing producer/runtime tests unchanged and passing

commands.result: 335 passed, 7 failed; the 7 failures are all in scripts/test_dev_environment_lease_deploy_contract.py (deploy-script contracts: restart admission, release-case retire action, provider gate), files this task does not touch

known_limits: Deployment credential: the capital reader reuses the runtime-manager/deployment capital read principal env (RUNTIME_MANAGER_CAPITAL_SERVICE_TOKEN or DEPLOYMENT_CAPITAL_SERVICE_TOKEN, optionally _FILE). If the producer or worker environment does not carry it, the producer fails closed with budget_unavailable: capital_pool, and the order gate keeps its previous resolution path (reader not built). Whether the hosted environment provides that principal to these containers is not verified here.
ledger_cash is only refreshed by paper_fill_simulated events; cash changes with no fill event (for example futures settlement) are not reflected until the next fill.
available_cash = min(ledger cash, equity - reserved margin): conservative for futures margin, exact for cash shares.
Pre-existing asset-class gating is still done by the order gate, not by candidate generation.
